description: This file implements a gated frame aggregator in a frame processing pipeline, enabling conditional accumulation and release of frames based on user-defined gate open/close functions. It defines the `GatedAggregator` class which inherits from `FrameProcessor`, managing internal state to control frame buffering and forwarding depending on custom logic.

classes.name: GatedAggregator
classes.description: A frame processor that conditionally accumulates frames based on custom gate opening and closing functions. It manages an internal buffer and gate state, allowing frames to be released either immediately or after a gate state change.

methods.name: __init__( self, gate_open_fn, gate_close_fn, start_open, direction: FrameDirection = FrameDirection.DOWNSTREAM, )
methods.description: Initializes the GatedAggregator with user-defined gate functions, starting gate state, and frame direction.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes each incoming frame, updating the gate state based on gate functions, and either passing frames through or accumulating them depending on the gate state.

ctags.pattern: /^    async def process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection):$/
